details:
- Update to jdk-17.0.16+8
- CVE-2025-50106: fix 2D component vulnerability in Java SE allowing remote
  attackers to compromise the Java runtime via crafted input
- CVE-2025-30749: fix 2D rendering vulnerability in Java SE that could lead to
  application crash or remote code execution
- CVE-2025-30754: fix JSSE component vulnerability allowing unauthorized access
  to sensitive data over TLS connections
- CVE-2025-50059: fix Networking component vulnerability allowing unauthenticated
  remote attackers to access sensitive data in Java SE and GraalVM environments
